Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team found Redwood's latency/cost controls compelling. As discussed, Procurement wants a short Mutual Action Plan we can bring into our vendor intake.

Can you share a MAP draft that lists the procurement milestones (Ariba setup, W-9, banking details, PO issuance), owner names on your side, and a suggested target close date? Our timeline is driven by our July budget cycle, so anything that helps us close by end of July would be ideal.

Also: we use Ariba for vendor onboarding — is Redwood set up to accept Ariba vendor invites or will we need to register you as a standard vendor in Coupa/legacy portals? Luke (cc'd) is our procurement lead and will own the intake.

Thanks — Emily

Hi Emily — really appreciate the quick follow-up. Great to hear the demo resonated.

Please find attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP-draft.xlsx). High level milestone summary below — I copied Marissa (CS) and Rishi (Legal) so we can align on deliverables/timelines.

Proposed MAP milestones (summary):
- Milestone A — Procurement intake created in Ariba (if Ariba is preferred) or through standard vendor portal; Owner: Pinegrove Procurement (Luke) / Redwood AM (Karthik). Dependency: Pinegrove invites Redwood or provides vendor registration link. Target: 2026-07-12.
- Milestone B — Vendor forms & W-9 submitted; Owner: Pinegrove (Emily) to upload / Redwood to provide completed forms if required. Dependency: bank information verification. Target: 2026-07-15.
- Milestone C — Banking details & ACH setup (secure exchange); Owner: Pinegrove procurement + Redwood finance. Dependency: verification via secure portal or DocuSign. Target: 2026-07-18.
- Milestone D — Contract SOW & PO terms agreed, redlines resolved; Owner: Redwood Legal (Rishi) + Pinegrove Legal/Procurement. Dependency: initial draft sent and turnaround on redlines. Target: 2026-07-22.
- Milestone E — PO issued, vendor code assigned in Ariba, onboarding complete; Owner: Pinegrove Procurement / Redwood AM; Dependency: PO issuance/cutoff. Target close date: 2026-07-30.

Key asks from us:
1) Confirm Ariba is the system Pinegrove will use (we can accept Ariba invites; our finance ops will register once we receive the invite).
2) Please share your W-9 and preferred method for banking details (secure upload or signed DocuSign routing).
3) Any internal vendor policies (insurance limits, special KYC) we should be aware of.

I attached the MAP draft (spreadsheet) and a vendor-onboard checklist PDF that the finance team uses. If the milestones look good, can we lock target close date 2026-07-30 and formalize owners in the MAP?

Thanks — I can circle back with a short 15-min alignment call if helpful.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Karthik / Emily — quick legal note from my side:

- We can fast-track a standard SOW and vendor addendum; typical turnaround for an initial draft + consumer-friendly redline is ~3 business days once we have any special terms flagged by Pinegrove (e.g., data residency clauses, specific audit requirements).
- For banking verification, our legal + finance prefer DocuSign or a secure portal link rather than email attachments to satisfy audit trails. Emily, if Pinegrove can send bank account verification via DocuSign or an SFTP/secure upload, that keeps us compliant.
- If Pinegrove requires a specific contract template (procurement-provided PO terms), please route that to me early.

I'll review the MAP draft and add a short legal checklist into the same workbook (privacy/compliance touchpoints). Marissa — can you provide the typical onboarding lead time we log for Ariba vendor code creation (we can include an estimate in the MAP)?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
